description: This file contains automated API tests for employee workflows within the OrangeHRM system. It covers CRUD workflows for job titles, including creation, deletion, and pagination validation, employing the RestAssured library for HTTP requests and JUnit for testing structure.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkflowTests
classes.description: Test class for employee-related API workflows and backend validation scenarios.

methods.name: createAndDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Test for creating a job title and then deleting it, validating API responses and proper data handling.

methods.name: paginationValidation
methods.description: Test to verify that pagination parameters (limit and offset) are honored correctly by the API.

methods.name: deleteValidationShouldFailOnEmptyIds
methods.description: Test to ensure API rejects deletion requests with empty ID arrays, validating proper error handling.
